newsitem.title: USA: Russell Corp CEO backs analysts' forecast.
newsitem.headline: Russell Corp CEO backs analysts' forecast.

text.p: Russell Corp said on Thursday it supports outside analysts' consensus forecast that its earnings per share for 1997 will be $2.37.
"I have no reason to disagree with that," the chief executive, John Adams, said in an interview after he spoke to analysts at the annual Super Show trade exposition.
"Sales will be up in the high single digits and with better cost controls," he said.
For full-year 1996 the manufacturer of athletic apparel wear posted net income of $2.11 per share.
